The main takeaway from our work is that
the fiber-based phase detector is a promising candidate for the synchronization of microwave oscillations with mode-locked fiber-laser pulses.

the optical pulse train can be used to synchronize a microwave signal with a phase noise level of -133 dBc at 1 Hz offset frequency and a phase drift rate of 4×10(18) at 1 s averaging time, which is sufficient for many applications.
